summary.name: Liquid Motion is a supplemental Motion Design and Cinematography style, added as a user-requested direction. It is a 2D or 3D motion vocabulary and does not require glass, iridescence, or validated fluid simulation.
summary.visualIdentity: Deliberate stretching, stringing, merging, splitting, and elastic settling of droplets or viscous forms define the look. Choose a 2D or 3D surface language and keep highlights from obscuring contours. SDF metaballs approximate a fluid appearance without accurate physics. Surface material beyond these cues is unspecified.
summary.suitableUses: Catalog guidance favors logo formations and abstract transitions, where a drop lands, spreads, and gathers into a wordmark. Listed uses include brand stings, beverage or cosmetics titles, event openers, and music-led promos with a supplied track. Other uses are inferred, not explicitly stated.
summary.limitations: Metaballs cannot hold accurate lettering, so real text must be composited after formation and then remain rigid. Fluid behavior is not physically validated; splashes and collisions need a separate baked Blender simulation. Pairing is advised only when real text or a supplied track must set timing. Other limits are unspecified.
summary.palette: Example tokens apply only when no approved palette is supplied: background #171E2B, foreground #F5ECE0, accent_1 #758FC0, accent_2 #C889A6. Use discrete tokens, since gradients are disabled. Task or reference colors override these and must stay exact. Two-color checks give foreground on background 14.285:1, background on accent_1 5.128:1, and background on accent_2 6.034:1; recheck composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion derives from seekable composition time, so video has no live loop. Smooth elastic settling suits the fluid action, while deliberate cuts, impacts, and reading holds stay sharp. Optional catalog references apply only when scene assets support them: motion-003 drop-and-growth, motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-014 morphing orb, motion-015 narrative steps, and motion-038 punctuation zoom. Choosing none is valid. Interactive behavior is unspecified.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified; the style mandates no music, voice, or effects. Music-led use requires a supplied track and a precomputed beat map, with merges or splits only on major beats. Restrained impact accents or silence can support drop moments. Narration needs clear space, and speech intelligibility and synchronization must be verified.
summary.assetRequirements: No asset list is supplied, so requirements are unspecified. Inferred needs include real font files for any wordmark, exact logo geometry, and an actual punctuation mark for motion-038. Music-led use needs an authorized track. Do not invent brand marks or copy.
summary.combinations: Explicit suggestions: style-093 for real kinetic typography that takes over once the liquid forms a wordmark and then stays rigid, and style-105 for beat-mapped merges and splits with a licensed track. Avoid long kinetic type sequences and SDF approximations for final legible text. Other combinations are unspecified.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, validation, and export, using a paused, seekable GSAP timeline. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or verifiably blocked, and the reason must be recorded. Choose the style renderer by visual fidelity among WebGL/GLSL, Three.js, p5.js, and Paper.js. Verify forward, backward, and direct seeks plus decoded frames.
